title: Seena e sibte nabi paar layeen wawaila
body:
Seena E Sibte Nabi Paar Layeen Wavela
Gardan E Ibne Ali Khanjar E Keen Wavela
1. Naiza E Ibne Anas Seena E Akber Afsoos
Dast E Abbas E Ali Teghe Hazeen Wavela
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dukhtar'aan E Ali O Fatima Dar Balwa E Aam
Eeyi Falak Chun Na Fitadyi Ba Da Az Wavela
